_note: Synthetic demo policies for the fictional company Acme Corp (matches phishhook/directory.json). Version these with the code.

policies.title: Changing an employee's or vendor's bank details
steps: Never change bank or direct-deposit details because of an email alone.
Employees submit the change themselves in the payroll portal.
For vendors, call the number in the vendor master file, not one in the email.
A second person approves the change before the next pay run.
policies.next_action: Don't change anything from this email. Call the person or vendor on the number already on file, and have the change approved by a second person.

policies.title: Requests for W-2s, SSNs, or employee records
steps: Employee tax forms and SSNs are never sent by email.
Requests from executives still go through an HR ticket.
Confirm the request by phone with the requester before acting.
policies.next_action: Don't send any employee data. Ask for an HR ticket and confirm by phone using the company directory.

policies.title: Urgent payments, wires, and gift cards
steps: Acme never pays anyone with gift cards.
New or changed payees need two approvers in the finance system.
An executive asking you to skip approval is a reason to verify, not to hurry.
policies.next_action: Don't pay or buy anything yet. Follow the two-approver process and call the requester on a number from the directory.

policies.title: Passwords and sign-in codes
steps: IT never asks for your password or sign-in code by email.
Sign in only by typing the portal address yourself.
policies.next_action: Don't sign in from this email. Type the portal address yourself, and report the email to IT.
